snippet.title: Stabjack Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Stabjack is a combination of Roguelike Deckbuilder and comic noir tragedy coming to Steam in 2026.
Play the public Alpha Demo now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913420/Stabjack/?beta=0
This game plunges you into a dark, gritty, demon-infested world, with gameplay that builds on the familiar concepts of Blackjack. Can a talking knife help you solve your wife’s murder, or is this just the beginning of your descent into madness?
